included: A caller-visible, independently invokable package capability that returns a simulator record, a physical channel/state/trajectory result, a replayable source process, or explicitly bounded certification/research evidence.
Workload adapters and isolated plugins are counted separately when they have their own public entry point, dependency boundary, and output contract.
excluded: Types, IRs, guards, layout helpers, native loaders, controlled fixtures, and runners that only support another service.
Downstream inference, decoder-floor/headroom analysis, hardware datasets, unimplemented scientific bridges, and repository-only experiments.

api_surface: Installed Python API only; the distribution currently installs no console-script entry point. Optional PyMatching and CUDA-Q capabilities require their declared extras, and CUDA-Q runs in the retained aiqec environment as a separate process.

acceptance_execution.reason: Service acceptance is process-isolated and lane-scheduled because the catalog spans Torch, QuTiP/cuQuantum/CuPy, fused CUDA extensions, CPU-exclusive quantum-bath work, and an isolated CUDA-Q plugin. A single long-lived pytest process can exit 139 after otherwise passing service groups; fresh processes reset native allocator/lifetime state, while the declared lanes keep GPU/native work serial and allow only bounded independent CPU-light concurrency. The eight GPU PEPO owner files additionally declare PyTorch expandable segments in their private fresh-exec environments; the supervisor and unrelated services do not inherit that allocator setting.

services.name: Classical finite-RTN source-to-record chain

controls.semantics: Preserve one-field marginals via per-field cycle permutations while breaking temporal order and source-to-mechanism alignment. The finite-R arm is exchangeable and retains part of pooled lag covariance; it is not a genuinely Markovian generative null.
Collapse the source amplitude to zero and emit the constant Theta(0) control arm.

external_inputs: Declared single-RTN or finite log-spaced RTN-sum configuration, or explicit SourceTimeline NPZ
outputs: Shared-source canonical record arm
Matched-marginal permutation negative-control record arm
Source-off Theta(0) negative-control record arm
Evaluator-only replayable timeline and per-cycle mechanism parameters
services.note: The source is a finite sum of log-spaced RTNs whose sum-of-Lorentzians approximates 1/f only over the declared band. The registered free-induction research diagnostic tests separately declared one-qubit lifts and does not upgrade the source, production channel, or record to a CP-divisibility claim. This is not a hardware-data service.

outputs: Replayable SourceTimeline with evaluator-side latent/source arrays
services.note: These are public timeline primitives, not turnkey record carriers. CoupledCycleNoiseProcess deliberately accepts only RTNSource/OneOverFDriftSource. PhaseBurst remains unbounded; TemporalStorm is a reduced observed HMM-memory comparator.

external_inputs: Small n-qubit state, local gates/Kraus channels and measurement definitions
outputs: Exact density matrix, enumerated branch probabilities, differentiable measurement/detector probabilities
services.note: The exact fused CUDA path is an acceleration of this service; it does not change the c128 mathematical contract.

services.name: Exact small-N Axis-1 joint-L state and measurement-record carrier
external_inputs: Compiler-sealed Axis-1 SubstepSchedule, optional per-substep parameters, readout/reset instrument and XOR wiring
outputs: Exact small-N state/branch law, canonical RecordBatch, detection_events.b8 and obs_flips_actual.b8
services.note: This is the dense execution dependency of the classical 1/f chain. It intentionally does not fabricate Stim/DEM/decoder semantics for analog joint-L records.

services.name: Fused d3 within-cycle state-vector MCWF carrier
external_inputs: XZZXSchedule and explicit RunSpec
outputs: PackedShotBatch with c64 screening or c128 candidate provenance
services.note: c64 is restricted to optimization screening. Final/certification candidates remain c128.

services.name: Restricted Axis-1 one-dimensional MCWF/MPS execution
external_inputs: Sealed Axis-1 schedule, local dimensions and explicit approximation controls including max_bond=None or a strict positive integer
outputs: Restricted execution/evidence manifest, sampled record frequencies and actual-Quimb-split approximation ledger with explicit path aggregation
services.note: This is a finite-microstep verification slice, not a production full-dxd/full-record backend. Finite qubit two-site unitary caps ledger every actual Quimb forward-swap/operator/reverse-swap split. Exact branches use incoming-probability weighting; sampled paths average over the declared trajectory count, including zero-event paths. Each gate occurrence authenticates complete trajectory coverage or unit branch mass and fails closed when incomplete. Actual finite-bond loss requires both explicit heuristic worst-cut and path-total discarded-weight gates for restricted acceptance; an observed lossless capped run does not. Local discarded fractions are not a global error bound; uncapped Kraus/jump norms retain separate physical branch-probability semantics.

services.name: Single-wire 2D qutrit PEPS trajectory carrier
external_inputs: XZZXSchedule and explicit c128 RunSpec
outputs: PackedShotBatch and truncation/contraction ledgers separating candidate, selected, and transactionally applied FET evidence
services.note: Current feasibility carrier. The FET writeback boundary now fails closed, rolls back both endpoints transactionally, and uses a declared private solver RNG without advancing ambient CPU/CUDA streams. Those are engineering guarantees only: the fresh-process replay bound to repair commit c8c553e passes scoped replay, fallback, RNG-neutrality, and strict-target d3 entropy checks, but all four cases are all-noop, all 64 cuts are solver-health RED, and zero authenticated rank-reducing writebacks leave the non-degeneracy gate RED. The literature bridge from local FET fidelity to entropy/full-record faithfulness remains open; d5/d7 scientific claims remain provisional.

services.name: Two-dimensional qutrit density-matrix PEPO carrier
external_inputs: Rotated-XZZX layout, qutrit channel stream, and truncation controls
outputs: Density-matrix PEPO state, terminal-observable probability, and truncation/negativity ledgers
services.note: Retained research carrier with executable d3 reference checks and d-generic implementation. It is not a production record backend; selective stabilizer sampling is not a current entry point, and record-level finite-truncation faithfulness plus d5/d7 scientific claims remain open. Exact-density reference groups and the three high-memory integration checks are separate gpu_serial files so service acceptance gives each a bounded fresh native/CUDA process lifetime. All eight GPU PEPO owner files explicitly use the current PyTorch expandable-segments allocator contract in their private child processes; layout/diagnostic guards and the host seam remain CPU-only.
